blocks.summary: Core motivation, Wang Yangming quote, three research questions, and contributions overview.
World-Action models, open robot research ecosystems, and empirical model design methodology.
Modular composable model (streams, modules, 6 architectures), training runtime, deployment runtime, evaluation protocol.
Controlled studies on inheriting world priors, building world-action synergy, and consolidating across domains.
Pretrained model architecture, 6.4K-hour heterogeneous data curation, 8 simulation benchmarks, and real-robot evaluations.
Limitations and future work, training hyperparameters (Tables 9-10), real-robot protocols (Tables 11-12, Figures 18-21), and full benchmark results (Tables 13-20).
21 figures covering system overview, model architectures, serving latency, empirical study curves, and real-robot setups.
20 tables covering architecture ablations, recipe summary, pretraining data mixtures, real-robot evaluations, hyperparameters, and simulation benchmark results.
